author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Diagonal composition as in the reference, built in a 45-degree axis frame: claw hammer head top-right with an r10 claw, a fist across the handle with two curled r5 knuckles and a crease, the handle end showing below the fist. Reads as a hand gripping a hammer at 48 in both themes; the before's polylines read as abstract shapes.
omissions: Four fingers reduced to two (8-unit crease spacing on a 45-degree fist); the forearm and the wavy sleeve line of the reference.
